1. Description

This pairing examines the portion of North America’s land area covered by snow. Snow cover varies daily, so this feature takes a wider view by examining seasonal and annual averages. Technically, it covers all of North America except for Greenland. It builds on Figures 1 and 2 of EPA’s Snow Cover indicator and includes the following components:

  • Historical observations since 1981, which was the first year with complete data available using the newest processing methods.
  • Modeled projections from 2015 to 2100 for four climate scenarios.
  • A modeled hindcast from 1950 to 2014.
